description: No charge here. Plans the assets a saved spec needs (GUI set with its finished screen, icons, thumbnail, props, music) in the spec's style and returns one total in credits plus a kit projectId. Show the user the total; then draft/approve/generate on that projectId exactly as after plan_kit (generate takes confirmCredits). The kit zip includes the spec files. Calling it again returns the same project.
name: asset_kit
title: Quote the matching asset kit
